subject: App Crash Report — iPhone 15 iOS 17.4
body:
Hi Support Team,

I'm experiencing repeated crashes on my iPhone 15 running iOS 17.4 with app version 3.1.0.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open the app
2. Navigate to the Settings tab
3. Tap on 'Account Details'
4. App crashes immediately with no error message

This happens 100% of the time. I've tried reinstalling but the issue persists.

Device: iPhone 15
OS: iOS 17.4
App Version: 3.1.0

Please fix ASAP as I rely on this app for work.

Best,
John

subject: Login Issue Since v3.0.1 Update
body:
Hello,

Since updating to v3.0.1 last week I cannot log in to my account.

When I enter my email and password and tap 'Sign In', the loading spinner appears for about 5 seconds then disappears without logging me in or showing an error.

Device: Samsung Galaxy S22
OS: Android 13
App Version: 3.0.1

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open app
2. Enter valid credentials
3. Tap Sign In
4. Spinner appears then vanishes — not logged in

I've tried resetting my password, still same issue.

Thanks

subject: Data Loss Problem — Urgent
body:
URGENT — I have lost 3 weeks of data after the 3.0.5 update.

All my notes and task history before March 2024 are gone. The app shows an empty state when I tap on History.

Device: Google Pixel 7
OS: Android 14
App Version: 3.0.5

Steps:
1. Update app to 3.0.5
2. Open app
3. Navigate to History tab
4. All previous entries gone

This is critical — I need that data for work. Please escalate immediately.

subject: Notification Bug — Not Receiving Alerts
body:
Hi,

Push notifications stopped working after I upgraded to iOS 17.1.

Device: iPhone 14 Pro
OS: iOS 17.1
App Version: 3.1.0

Steps:
1. Enable notifications in app settings (confirmed allowed in iOS Settings too)
2. Set a reminder for 5 minutes from now
3. Wait — no notification arrives

Tried toggling permissions off and on. No improvement.

Regards, Sarah

subject: Sync Failure Between iPad and iPhone
body:
Hello Support,

My data is not syncing between my iPhone and iPad. I create an item on iPhone and it never appears on iPad, even after waiting 30 minutes.

iPhone 13, iOS 16.6, App v3.0.5
iPad Pro 11', iPadOS 16.6, App v3.0.5

Steps:
1. Create new task on iPhone
2. Open iPad (signed into same account)
3. Task does not appear
4. Pull to refresh — still missing

Both devices are on the same WiFi network.

Thank you

subject: App Freezes on Android 14 — Galaxy S23
body:
Hi,

The app freezes completely on my Galaxy S23 running Android 14.

Device: Samsung Galaxy S23
OS: Android 14
App Version: 3.1.0

Steps to reproduce:
1. Open app
2. Go to the Dashboard
3. Scroll down rapidly
4. App becomes unresponsive — must force-kill

Happens consistently. Clearing cache does not help.

Best, Mike

subject: Search Not Returning Results
body:
Hi support,

The search feature is completely broken for me. I type in exact words that I know are in my notes and get zero results.

Device: OnePlus 10 Pro
OS: Android 13
App Version: 3.0.5

Steps:
1. Open app and navigate to Search
2. Type 'meeting notes' (I have 20 notes with this phrase)
3. Results show: 'No items found'

Please help — search is critical for my use.

Regards

subject: Feature Request: Dark Mode Support
body:
Hello,

I love the app but I would really appreciate a dark mode option. I use the app late at night and the bright white background is hard on my eyes. Many apps have this feature now and it would greatly improve my experience.

Thank you for considering this!

Best, Laura

subject: Request: Export to PDF Functionality
body:
Hi Team,

It would be incredibly useful to export my task lists and notes as PDF files directly from the app. I often need to share progress reports with my manager and currently I have to copy everything manually.

A simple export button would save me 30 minutes every week.

Thank you

subject: Suggestion: Biometric Login
body:
Hello,

I'd love to see Face ID / fingerprint login support. Typing my long password every time is inconvenient, especially on mobile. Almost every other app of this type supports biometrics now.

Would really improve day-to-day usability.

Thanks!

subject: Suggestion for Improvement: Calendar Integration
body:
Hi,

I think adding calendar integration (Google Calendar / Apple Calendar) would make this app a complete productivity solution. Right now I have to switch between two apps to manage my tasks and calendar.

Even a read-only calendar view inside the app would be great.

Best regards

subject: Feature Request: Team Collaboration
body:
Dear Team,

Our company is evaluating your app for team use. One key missing feature is real-time collaboration — multiple users editing the same project simultaneously. This is a deal-breaker for us at the enterprise level.

If this is on the roadmap, please let us know the ETA.

Regards, Enterprise Team

subject: Feedback: Offline Mode Would Be Great
body:
Hello,

I travel frequently and often have no internet access. Having full offline mode with sync when back online would make this app perfect for frequent travelers like me.

Currently the app is unusable without connection.

Thanks for considering!

subject: Subscription Price Too High
body:
Hello,

I've been a user for 2 years and the recent price increase to $15/month is simply too much for what's offered. Competitors charge $5-8/month for the same or more features. I'm considering cancelling unless pricing is reviewed.

Thanks

subject: Very Slow App Performance
body:
Hi,

The app has become extremely slow over the past few months. Loading the dashboard takes 8-10 seconds. Switching tabs takes 3-4 seconds. This was not an issue before. I'm considering switching to a competitor if performance doesn't improve.

Frustrated user

subject: Poor Customer Support Experience
body:
To Whom It May Concern,

I submitted a support ticket 2 weeks ago about a billing issue and have received only one automated response. No real human has contacted me. I am a premium subscriber and this level of support is unacceptable.

Disappointed

subject: Too Many Ads in Free Tier
body:
Hello,

The number of ads in the free tier has increased drastically and they now appear every 2-3 actions. This makes the app nearly unusable without paying. I understand monetization but this is excessive.

Regards

subject: App Uses Too Much Storage
body:
Hi,

I noticed the app is using 600MB of storage on my phone which is far too much. I have limited storage and this app is taking up a disproportionate amount. Please optimize storage usage or add a 'Clear Cache' option in settings.

Thanks

subject: Love the New Dashboard Design!
body:
Hi Team,

Just wanted to say the new dashboard in v3.1.0 is absolutely beautiful. The redesign made everything so much more intuitive. Great work by your design team!

Keep up the excellent work. This is my go-to productivity app.

Thanks!

subject: Outstanding App — Highly Recommend
body:
Hello,

I've been using your app for 18 months and it keeps getting better. The v3.0.1 update was especially impressive. Performance improvements are noticeable and the new features are exactly what I needed.

Please keep it up! Recommending it to my entire team.

Best

subject: Great Customer Support Experience
body:
Hi,

I had a billing issue last week and your support team resolved it within 2 hours. That's exceptional service. The rep (Alex) was courteous and efficient.

Just wanted to share positive feedback. Keep it up!

Kind regards

subject: Crash When Uploading Large Files
body:
Hello,

The app crashes every time I try to upload files larger than 10MB.

Device: iPhone 13 Pro
OS: iOS 16.6
App Version: 3.0.1

Steps:
1. Tap the '+' button to add attachment
2. Select a 15MB PDF from Files
3. Upload progress bar appears
4. At ~60% progress, app crashes

Consistent across multiple files and network conditions.

Regards, Tom

subject: Two-Factor Authentication Not Working
body:
Hi Support,

The 2FA SMS codes are not being delivered to my phone. I enabled 2FA last week and now I cannot log in at all because I never receive the code.

Device: Samsung Galaxy A52
OS: Android 12
App Version: 3.0.5

Steps:
1. Open app
2. Enter email and password
3. 2FA screen appears — wait for SMS
4. SMS never arrives (checked spam, tried resend 5 times)

This is a blocker — I cannot access my account.

Urgently, David

subject: Widget Crashes Home Screen
body:
Hello,

The home screen widget crashes my launcher when I try to add it. Goes directly back to home screen after selecting widget.

Device: Pixel 7a
OS: Android 14
App Version: 3.1.0

Steps:
1. Long press home screen
2. Select Widgets
3. Find app widget
4. Drag to home screen — launcher crashes

Reproducible every time.

Thanks

subject: Request: Apple Watch App
body:
Hello,

An Apple Watch companion app would be a fantastic addition. Being able to check and check-off tasks from my wrist would save a lot of time. Many of your competitors already have this. Please consider adding it!

Thank you

subject: Suggestion: Custom Themes
body:
Hi Team,

It would be great if users could choose from different color themes beyond just light and dark mode. Custom accent colors would let users personalize the experience.

Just a thought — keep up the good work!

Best

subject: No Refund for Cancelled Subscription
body:
Hello,

I cancelled my annual subscription mid-year and was told I would not receive a refund for the unused months. This is unacceptable and against consumer protection rules in my country. I expect a pro-rata refund.

Regards

subject: App Has Transformed My Productivity
body:
Hi,

I just wanted to say this app has genuinely changed how I work. I used to miss deadlines and feel overwhelmed. After 6 months with your app, I'm on top of everything. The recurring tasks feature is a lifesaver.

Thank you!

subject: Impressed by the Accessibility Features
body:
Hello Team,

As someone with low vision, I want to thank you for excellent accessibility support. The dynamic text sizing and VoiceOver compatibility work flawlessly. Very few apps get this right.

Keep it up!

subject: Quick Question About Storage Limits
body:
Hi,

I'm a free user and wanted to know what the storage limit is before I need to upgrade to premium. I can't find this information clearly in the app.

Also, love the app — very well designed!

Thanks
